P 1.loc: Below the collarbone, toward the shoulder: in the 1st space between the ribs, 6 cun from the midline, 1 cun below the hollow under the outer end of the collarbone.
P 1.act: Front-Mu point of the Lung: opens the chest, calms coughing and breathlessness.

P 5.loc: In the elbow crease, arm straight and palm up, on the thumb side of the large biceps tendon.
P 5.act: Clears Lung Heat, makes Qi descend, transforms phlegm.

P 6.loc: Front of the forearm, 7 cun above the wrist crease, on the line joining LU 5 to LU 9.
P 6.act: Xi-Cleft point of the Lung: calms acute coughs and asthma.

P 7.loc: On the thumb edge of the forearm, 1.5 cun above the wrist crease, in the small hollow just above the bony bump (radial styloid).
P 7.act: Helps Lung Qi descend and spread, expels Wind, frees the head and neck.

P 9.loc: In the wrist crease on the thumb side, in the hollow just beside the radial artery (where you take the pulse). Press gently.
P 9.act: Yuan-Source point of the Lung: tonifies Lung Qi and Yin.

P 10.loc: Halfway along the 1st metacarpal (the thumb bone in the palm), where the skin of the palm meets the skin of the back of the hand.
P 10.act: Clears Lung Heat, soothes the throat.

P 11.loc: At the corner of the thumbnail, outer side, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail.
P 11.act: Soothes a sore throat and clears Heat.

GI 4.loc: Back of the hand, between the 1st and 2nd metacarpals, at the midpoint of the 2nd metacarpal on the thumb side.
GI 4.act: Expels Wind, relieves pain, frees the face and head. With LR 3 (the Four Gates): moves Qi and Blood.

GI 10.loc: On the thumb side of the forearm, 2 cun below LI 11.
GI 10.act: Tonifies Qi, soothes the arm and helps digestion.

GI 11.loc: Elbow bent, at the outer end of the elbow crease, halfway between LU 5 and the bony bump of the elbow.
GI 11.act: Clears Heat, cools the Blood, eliminates Dampness, calms itching.

GI 20.loc: In the groove running from the nose down to the mouth, level with the middle of the nostril.

E 21.loc: 4 cun above the navel, 2 cun on each side of the midline.
E 21.act: Harmonizes the Stomach, eases stomach pain, helps digestion.

E 25.loc: Level with the navel, 2 cun on each side.
E 25.act: Front-Mu point of the Large Intestine: regulates the belly and bowel movements.

E 34.loc: 2 cun above the upper outer corner of the kneecap.
E 34.act: Xi-Cleft point of the Stomach: calms acute stomach pain and knee pain.

E 35.loc: Knee bent, in the hollow below the kneecap, on the outer side of the kneecap tendon.
E 35.act: Soothes the knee, expels local Cold and Dampness.

E 36.loc: 3 cun below ST 35 (outer hollow of the knee), 1 finger-width outside the crest of the shinbone.
E 36.act: Tonifies the Qi and Blood of the Spleen and Stomach, strengthens the whole body.

E 37.loc: 3 cun below ST 36, 1 finger-width outside the crest of the shinbone.
E 37.act: Lower He-Sea point of the Large Intestine: regulates the bowels, eliminates Damp-Heat.

E 40.loc: On the leg, halfway between the knee and the outer ankle bone, 2 finger-widths outside the crest of the shinbone.
E 40.act: Transforms Phlegm and Dampness, calms the mind.

E 44.loc: Top of the foot, between the 2nd and 3rd toes, at the edge of the web.
E 44.act: Clears Stomach Heat, soothes the gums and face.

Rt 1.loc: At the inner corner of the big toenail, 0.1 cun from the corner of the nail.
Rt 1.act: Helps the Spleen hold the Blood, calms the mind.

Rt 3.loc: Inner edge of the foot, in the hollow behind and below the head of the 1st metatarsal (just past the bump at the base of the big toe).
Rt 3.act: Yuan-Source point of the Spleen: tonifies the Spleen, transforms Dampness.

Rt 4.loc: Inner edge of the foot, in the hollow in front of and below the base of the 1st metatarsal.
Rt 4.act: Harmonizes the Spleen and Stomach, eases belly pain.

Rt 6.loc: 3 cun above the tip of the inner ankle bone, just behind the edge of the shinbone.
Rt 6.act: Meeting point of the three Yin channels of the leg: tonifies the Spleen, nourishes Blood and Yin, calms the mind.

Rt 8.loc: 3 cun below SP 9, just behind the inner edge of the shinbone.
Rt 8.act: Xi-Cleft point of the Spleen: moves the Blood, eases painful periods.

Rt 9.loc: Inner side of the leg, in the hollow below the top of the shinbone (below the inner bump of the knee).
Rt 9.act: Drains Dampness, especially from the lower body.

Rt 10.loc: Knee bent, 2 cun above the upper inner corner of the kneecap, on the bulge of the muscle.
Rt 10.act: “Sea of Blood”: moves and cools the Blood, soothes the skin.

C 5.loc: Inner side of the wrist, 1 cun above the crease, on the little-finger side, against the tendon.
C 5.act: Tonifies Heart Qi, calms the mind.

C 6.loc: Inner side of the wrist, 0.5 cun above the crease, on the little-finger side, against the tendon.
C 6.act: Xi-Cleft point of the Heart: nourishes Heart Yin, stops night sweats.

C 7.loc: In the wrist crease on the little-finger side, in the hollow against the tendon.
C 7.act: Yuan-Source point of the Heart: calms the mind, helps sleep and memory.

C 8.loc: In the palm, between the 4th and 5th metacarpals, where the tip of your little finger lands when you make a fist.

IG 19.loc: In front of the ear, in the hollow that forms when you open your mouth.
IG 19.act: Soothes the ears: ringing in the ears (tinnitus), blocked ear.

V 2.loc: In the small hollow at the inner end of the eyebrow.
V 2.act: Soothes the eyes and headaches in the forehead.

V 12.loc: On the back, 1.5 cun on each side of the spine, below the 2nd thoracic vertebra.
V 12.act: “Wind Gate”: expels Wind, strengthens your defenses against colds.

V 13.loc: On the back, 1.5 cun on each side of the spine, below the 3rd thoracic vertebra.
V 13.act: Back-Shu point of the Lung: tonifies Lung Qi.

V 15.loc: On the back, 1.5 cun on each side of the spine, below the 5th thoracic vertebra.
V 15.act: Back-Shu point of the Heart: tonifies the Heart, calms the mind.

V 17.loc: On the back, 1.5 cun on each side of the spine, below the 7th thoracic vertebra, roughly level with the tips of the shoulder blades.
V 17.act: Meeting point of Blood: nourishes and moves the Blood.

V 18.loc: On the back, 1.5 cun on each side of the spine, below the 9th thoracic vertebra.
V 18.act: Back-Shu point of the Liver: nourishes Liver Blood, soothes the eyes.

V 20.loc: On the back, 1.5 cun on each side of the spine, below the 11th thoracic vertebra.
V 20.act: Back-Shu point of the Spleen: tonifies the Spleen, transforms Dampness.

V 21.loc: On the back, 1.5 cun on each side of the spine, below the 12th thoracic vertebra.
V 21.act: Back-Shu point of the Stomach: tonifies the Stomach.

V 23.loc: On the lower back, 1.5 cun on each side of the spine, below the 2nd lumbar vertebra, at waist level.
V 23.act: Back-Shu point of the Kidney: tonifies the Kidney, strengthens the lower back.

V 25.loc: On the lower back, 1.5 cun on each side of the spine, below the 4th lumbar vertebra, level with the top of the pelvis.
V 25.act: Back-Shu point of the Large Intestine: regulates bowel movements, soothes the lower back.

V 28.loc: On the sacrum, 1.5 cun on each side of the midline, level with the 2nd sacral hole.
V 28.act: Back-Shu point of the Bladder: regulates urination.

V 40.loc: In the middle of the crease behind the knee.
V 40.act: Soothes the back and knees, cools the Blood.

V 43.loc: On the back, 3 cun on each side of the spine, below the 4th thoracic vertebra, at the inner edge of the shoulder blade.
V 43.act: Tonifies Qi and Yin in long-standing weakness.

V 60.loc: In the hollow between the outer ankle bone and the Achilles tendon.
V 60.act: Soothes the back, neck and head.

V 62.loc: In the hollow just below the tip of the outer ankle bone.
V 62.act: Calms the mind, soothes the neck and back.

Rn 1.loc: On the sole of the foot, in the hollow that forms when you curl your toes, at the front third of the sole.
Rn 1.act: Draws down what rises to the head, calms the mind, grounds you before sleep.

Rn 2.loc: Inner edge of the foot, in the hollow below the bump of the navicular bone (in front of and below the ankle bone).

Rn 3.loc: In the hollow between the inner ankle bone and the Achilles tendon, level with the tip of the ankle bone.
Rn 3.act: Yuan-Source point of the Kidney: tonifies Kidney Yin and Yang.

Rn 6.loc: In the hollow just below the tip of the inner ankle bone.
Rn 6.act: Nourishes Yin, moistens the throat and eyes, helps sleep.

Rn 7.loc: 2 cun above KI 3, at the front edge of the Achilles tendon.
Rn 7.act: Tonifies the Kidney, regulates sweating and body fluids.

Rn 27.loc: Below the collarbone, 2 cun on each side of the midline.
Rn 27.act: Makes Lung Qi descend, calms coughing and breathlessness.

MC 6.loc: Inner side of the forearm, 2 cun above the wrist crease, between the two tendons.
MC 6.act: Opens the chest, makes Stomach Qi descend (nausea), calms the mind.

MC 7.loc: In the middle of the wrist crease, between the two tendons.
MC 7.act: Clears Heart Heat, calms the mind.

MC 8.loc: In the center of the palm, between the 2nd and 3rd metacarpals, where the tip of your middle finger lands when you make a fist.

TR 5.loc: Back of the forearm, 2 cun above the wrist crease, between the two bones.
TR 5.act: Expels Wind-Heat, soothes the sides of the head and the ears.

TR 6.loc: Back of the forearm, 3 cun above the wrist crease, between the two bones.
TR 6.act: Moves Qi, helps the stools move down, soothes the ribs.

TR 17.loc: Behind the earlobe, in the hollow between the jaw and the bone behind the ear.
TR 17.act: Soothes the ears and jaw, expels Wind.

VB 20.loc: Below the back of the skull, in the hollow between the two large neck muscles.
VB 20.act: “Wind Pool”: expels Wind, eases headaches, dizziness and a stiff neck.

VB 21.loc: On top of the shoulder, halfway between the base of the neck and the tip of the shoulder.
VB 21.act: Relaxes the shoulders and neck, makes Qi descend.

VB 34.loc: Outer side of the leg, in the hollow in front of and below the head of the fibula.
VB 34.act: Meeting point of the tendons: relaxes the tendons, frees the Liver and Gallbladder.

VB 39.loc: 3 cun above the tip of the outer ankle bone, at the front edge of the fibula.
VB 39.act: Meeting point of marrow: nourishes the marrow and bones.

VB 40.loc: In the hollow in front of and below the outer ankle bone.
VB 40.act: Frees the Liver and Gallbladder, soothes the ankle and the ribs.

VB 41.loc: Top of the foot, in the hollow in front of where the 4th and 5th metatarsals meet.
VB 41.act: Moves Liver Qi, soothes the temples and tender breasts.

VB 43.loc: Top of the foot, between the 4th and 5th toes, at the edge of the web.
VB 43.act: Subdues Liver Yang, soothes the temples and ears.

F 2.loc: Top of the foot, between the big toe and the 2nd toe, at the edge of the web.

F 3.loc: Top of the foot, in the hollow between the 1st and 2nd metatarsals, in front of where their bases meet.
F 3.act: Yuan-Source point of the Liver: frees Liver Qi, settles the Yang, calms the mind.

F 5.loc: 5 cun above the tip of the inner ankle bone, on the inner face of the shinbone.
F 5.act: Eliminates Damp-Heat from the genital area.

F 8.loc: Knee bent, at the inner end of the knee crease, in the hollow in front of the tendons.
F 8.act: Nourishes Liver Blood, soothes the knee.

F 13.loc: On the side of the trunk, below the free end of the 11th rib.
F 13.act: Front-Mu point of the Spleen: harmonizes the Liver and Spleen.

F 14.loc: Below the nipple, in the 6th space between the ribs.
F 14.act: Front-Mu point of the Liver: frees Liver Qi, soothes the ribs.

VG 4.loc: On the lower back, on the midline, below the 2nd lumbar vertebra, at waist level.

VG 12.loc: On the midline of the back, below the 3rd thoracic vertebra.

VG 14.loc: On the midline, below the most prominent vertebra at the base of the neck.
VG 14.act: Releases the surface, clears Heat, strengthens Yang.

VG 20.loc: At the top of the head, where the midline crosses the line joining the tops of both ears.
VG 20.act: Lifts Qi, calms the mind, clears the head.

RM 3.loc: On the midline, 4 cun below the navel (1 cun above the pubic bone).
RM 3.act: Front-Mu point of the Bladder: regulates urination, eliminates Damp-Heat.

RM 4.loc: On the midline, 3 cun below the navel.
RM 4.act: Tonifies the Kidney, the original Qi and the Blood, grounds you.

RM 6.loc: On the midline, 1.5 cun below the navel.
RM 6.act: “Sea of Qi”: tonifies Qi and Yang.

RM 9.loc: On the midline, 1 cun above the navel.

RM 12.loc: On the midline, 4 cun above the navel, halfway between the navel and the base of the breastbone.
RM 12.act: Front-Mu point of the Stomach: tonifies and harmonizes the Stomach and Spleen, transforms Dampness.

RM 14.loc: On the midline, 6 cun above the navel, just below the tip of the breastbone.
RM 14.act: Front-Mu point of the Heart: calms the mind, opens the chest.

RM 17.loc: In the middle of the breastbone, between the two nipples.
RM 17.act: Meeting point of Qi: opens the chest, regulates breathing.

RM 22.loc: In the center of the hollow above the breastbone. Press gently downward, never toward the throat.
RM 22.act: Makes Lung Qi descend, loosens the throat, calms coughing.

Yin Tang.loc: Between the eyebrows, in the middle.
Yin Tang.act: Calms the mind, helps sleep, soothes the forehead and nose.

Tai Yang.loc: In the hollow of the temple, 1 cun behind the point midway between the end of the eyebrow and the outer corner of the eye.
Tai Yang.act: Eases headaches at the temples and soothes the eyes.

An Mian.loc: Behind the ear, halfway between TE 17 and GB 20.
An Mian.act: “Peaceful Sleep”: calms the mind, helps you fall asleep.

Ding Chuan.loc: 0.5 cun on each side of the most prominent vertebra at the base of the neck.

Nei Xi Yan.loc: Knee bent, in the hollow below the kneecap, on the inner side of the kneecap tendon.
Nei Xi Yan.act: Soothes the knee, expels local Cold and Dampness.

He Ding.loc: Above the kneecap, in the hollow at the middle of its upper edge.
He Ding.act: Moves Qi and Blood in the knee.

Bai Chong Wo.loc: Knee bent, 3 cun above the upper inner corner of the kneecap (1 cun above SP 10).
Bai Chong Wo.act: “Nest of a Hundred Insects”: calms itching.

Zi Gong.loc: 4 cun below the navel, 3 cun on each side of the midline.

Ah Shi.loc: The most tender point or points when you press around the painful area. Search with your thumb: you'll know you've found it when you say “ah, that's it”.

F 1.loc: On the big toe, outer side (toward the 2nd toe), 2 mm from the corner of the nail.
F 1.act: Warms and frees the Liver meridian, eases pain in the lower belly and genitals.

V 52.loc: On the lower back, 3 cun from the spine (four finger-widths), level with the 2nd lumbar vertebra, i.e. at the waist.
V 52.act: “Residence of the Will”: strengthens the Kidney, willpower and sexual health.
